candidates.name: Inverted Papilloma
support_spans: Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores that are lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium
Shows mucin-containing goblet cells. Neither cytologic atypia nor atypical mitotic figures are present
candidates.why: The presence of papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores and mucin-containing goblet cells is characteristic of inverted papilloma.
